notes.title: New Update: "Wheel of Fortune"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058434/782d20e0d9e1b4f1a35794a2ecffa159ce72ddda.png[/img]

### Wheel of Fortune
Now you can try your luck with the Wheel of Fortune!
Bet 5 of your skins, and they will be destroyed.
In return, you will have a chance to win unique skins from the new "RPG" collection.
But be careful, you might lose your skins and get nothing in return.
Good luck with the new "Wheel of Fortune" update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058434/6de877fbc8d525d5f3179e866304e0228eab0730.gif[/img]

Patch Notes:

Wheel of Fortune:
- Added new functionality allowing players to try their luck and win unique skins.
- New "RPG" Skin Collection: Added a new collection of skins with unique effects, backgrounds, and sounds.

Dark Theme:
- Added a dark theme for more comfortable use of the application in low light conditions.

Several fixes and improvements were also made.
Also, an item store was added in Steam with four items from the new collection.

We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements.
Try your luck and get new exciting skins!
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: End of the "Business" Event and Launch of the Discord Channel
notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemen, we remind you that the "[b]Business[/b]" event ends tomorrow (28.07.2024) at 11:00 UTC. We will take a snapshot of the top 25 players for the distribution of the legendary Business Gold skin. 
The other skins from the Business Collection will remain in the drop pool and will continue to drop from clicks. 
Don't miss your chance to get a unique reward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058434/7787ff47c1b584fa57951e3ee9cd4c3fa981e533.gif[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] The legendary skin will be available for purchase and sale on the marketplace from other players after the event.

### [b]Launch of the Discord Channel:[/b]

We are excited to announce the launch of our new Discord channel, where we will be posting news and updates. In the channel, you will be able to ask questions to the developers and communicate in your preferred language. 
Currently, chats are available in the following languages: English, Español, Français, Deutsch, Русский. 
We will be adding more channels upon user request.

[url=https://discord.gg/45pVxcYRVf]Join us on Discord[/url] to stay updated with all the news and updates! [https://discord.gg/45pVxcYRVf]

notes.title: The Hamster: Business Collection released
notes.content:
Congratulations!

The first event of "The Hamster" called "Business Collection" has started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058434/7787ff47c1b584fa57951e3ee9cd4c3fa981e533.gif[/img]

Event summary:
• All scores have been reset for the event.
• The leaderboard has been reset.
• 12 new skins of varying rarity and 1 legendary skin have been added.
• Event goal: The top 25 players with the highest scores will receive the exclusive "Business Collection" event skin, released in limited quantities.

Note: The legendary skin will no longer be available for acquisition after the event, but it can be bought and sold on the marketplace from other players.

Event duration: 19.07.2024 to 28.07.2024

Patch notes:
• Interface redesign.
• Improved skin inventory.
• Fixed minor leaderboard processing bugs.
• Added sound effects for all skins except the standard one.
• Added visual and sound effects for obtaining a new skin.
• Added visual and sound effects for legendary skins.
• Added settings menu: sound control, screen mode change.
• The "exit game" button has been moved to the settings menu.

notes.title: "Businessmen" Skin Collection for "The Hamster" is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058434/732c307fdfde7fb47abb3e0c720374983f00b9d1.png[/img]
Dear players,
We are excited to announce the upcoming release of a new skin collection for "The Hamster" called "Businessmen"! The event will be dedicated to the businessman hamster and will include 13 new skins:
[list]
[*] 4 common
[*] 3 uncommon
[*] 3 rare
[*] 2 epic
[*] 1 legendary
[/list]

Some of these skins will be available by tapping on the hamster. Others will be available for a limited time during the event.

The start and end dates of the event will be announced later, so stay tuned!

Now, the main points:
[list]
[*] All leaderboard points will be reset for fair play.
[*] The top 10 players with the highest scores will receive a unique legendary event skin (which can be sold or traded on the marketplace).
[*] This legendary skin will not be available in the drop pool from tapping, it cannot be obtained by any other means.
[*] IMPORTANT: Holders of this exclusive skin will enjoy a changed interface, new sounds, and additional visual effects.
[/list]

We will also add several skins to the store, which cannot be obtained by tapping the hamster.

Don't miss your chance to own a unique skin and upgrade your hamster!

Good luck and have fun playing!
